title: Excavation Entry Permit
name: Excavation Entry Permit
description: Controls personnel entry into excavations and trenches after checking support, access, atmosphere where relevant, water, plant interaction and emergency arrangements.

sections.title: EXCAVATION CONDITION
items: A competent person has inspected the excavation before entry
Sides, support / shoring / battering are suitable for current conditions
Spoil, materials and surcharge loads are controlled away from the edge
Safe access and egress are provided
Water ingress, instability and weather effects have been considered
Underground services exposed in the excavation are supported / protected as required

sections.title: ENTRY HAZARDS AND INTERFACES
items: Plant and vehicle movements cannot endanger people in the excavation
Falling objects and edge hazards are controlled
Atmospheric hazards have been considered and tested where the risk assessment requires it
Nearby services, lifting operations or simultaneous work are controlled
Entry is stopped if ground, water, support or atmospheric conditions change

sections.title: EMERGENCY AND EXIT
items: Emergency access and rescue arrangements are appropriate to the excavation
The site team knows how to raise the alarm
People are accounted for on completion
The excavation is left secure against unauthorised access
Any deterioration is reported for re-inspection
